page.layout: One page of text, with a column of names and numbers in list form running down the page, numbers set at the right of each line, and the text continuing below. No margin notes.

main_text.p: viginti annos ei attributat: ex cujus supputatione Sigonius hoc loco repofuit CCC. & XXXIX. Sed ex subjecta tabula tantum colliguntur CCC. & IX.
His adde annos tyrannidis, quos Ebraei superioribus inclusos arbitrantur.

Ex his concludo, si annis Iudicum annumeraveris annos tyrannidis, Othonielique tantum 40. attribueris, conflari annos CCCC. & IX. vel potius X. Sic etiam se tuetur numerus qui Act. 13. in libris vulgatis. Sed de hoc alias.

A mundi autem exordio ann. IIIIM. CCC. & III. ] hunc numerum conficit Gifelinus [?] ex his duobus locis. Pag. 40. scribit a mundi exordio usque ad excessum Iosue annos esse IIIM. DCCC. LXXX. & IIII. Hic vero scribit a die mortis Iosue in id tempus quo Samson defunctus est numerari annos CCCC. & XIX. Simul hi numeri efficiunt. 4303. Sigonius vero, qui superiori numero adjecerat viginti, hunc ita emendat, ut pro 3. reponat 23.
Non incuriose latentem, &c. ] Sic infra, quae non incuriose a nobis sunt digesta.

page.notes: Printed page 150 with running head "I. DRUSII NOTÆ". The first line of the page continues from the previous page. The numbers at the right of the list are set in a column and are kept on their lines. Doubtful readings: "Gifelinus" (the long s may be read as f), "Ahod" (may be Abod), "Chufan rasathaim" (the s/f letter form is unclear). The catchword "Heli" stands alone at the lower right below the last line.
